subject.title: fix(config): dedupe warning spam and slow restart storms

question: Should this PR keep the 30-second macOS LaunchAgent throttle, or should it preserve current main's 10-second policy while landing only the config log-dedupe fixes?
rationale: The branch mixes a clear config-warning spam fix with a managed-service recovery timing change, and that availability tradeoff needs maintainer intent rather than automated conflict resolution.

options.title: Preserve 10s and land dedupe
options.body: Rebase the branch, keep current main's 10-second LaunchAgent throttle and current security/docs behavior, and land the config warning plus invalid-reload dedupe after blockers are fixed.

options.title: Accept 30s with proof
options.body: Keep the 30-second LaunchAgent throttle only if maintainers explicitly accept slower recovery and add real macOS service proof showing restart behavior remains acceptable.

options.title: Split service policy out
options.body: Land the config log-dedupe repair separately and move launchd restart pacing plus service-log docs into a maintainer-owned follow-up.

recommendation.title: Preserve 10s and land dedupe
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, keep current main's 10-second LaunchAgent throttle and current security/docs behavior, and land the config warning plus invalid-reload dedupe after blockers are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns this PR, is assigned, and has recent current-main config/daemon history on the affected surfaces.
